name: QuickNode
description: Quicknode brings enterprise blockchain infrastructure management into Claude through a single connector. You can manage endpoints across 80+ chains and 135+ networks, monitor logs and usage, configure rate limits and security controls, and handle billing visibility from natural language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add QuickNode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add QuickNode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quicknode.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the QuickNode MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: QuickNode lists 19 MCP tools, including list-endpoints, get-endpoint, create-endpoint, delete-endpoint, list-endpoint-security, update-endpoint-security-options, create-security-rule, delete-security-rule, update-endpoint-rate-limits, list-endpoint-method-rate-limits, create-endpoint-method-rate-limit, and update-endpoint-method-rate-limit.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to QuickNode?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to QuickNode in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
QuickNode requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
QuickNode is developed by QuickNode. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
